audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of all seven temporary event-branch records: Haley’s darkroom responses and every genre branch of Sam’s concert. Every line, embedded conditional branch, band name, music term, gender selector, reaction, currency amount, and character voice was reviewed in full event context with canonical Pelican Town terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, friendship and prior-choice conditions, response IDs, placeholders, branch delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. Repeated concert lines were audited across all four branch records. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
